cases.requirement: Two peers advertise the same 32 KiB piece and ordinary libtorrent picking must produce at least one 16 KiB request when suppression is disabled.
Command exactly piece 0, offset 0, length 16384 to peer B. Raw wire evidence must show that request on B and none on A.
With the same second block still eligible, suppress ordinary picker traffic on both peers while the owned B request and response still succeed; zero unowned requests are allowed.
Hold the owned B request outstanding, destroy torrent/session, then require clean process exit, peer socket closure, and no hidden replay request.
